name: foscen
description: A focused, keyboard-first desktop container for web scenes.
author: ConteMan

scripts.build: node scripts/clean.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild src/preload/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist/preload/index.js --sourcemap && esbuild src/renderer/index.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=iife --outfile=dist/renderer/index.js --sourcemap && node scripts/copy-static.mjs
